Independent Your Zoo guide; not an official app or partnership.
Zoo presence and printed taxa from the current official public animal/adoption catalogue, checked 2026-11-05; selected public coverage, not a complete live stock inventory.
Biological research, scripts, licensed species images and recordings are linked once through the central taxon library.

OSM animal features can be stale. Exact official-name or official-link matches are documented; unmatched OSM labels are retained as unconfirmed map features with no species assignment. Automatic guide remains disabled pending content and location review.
This bundle covers Wildparadies Tripsdrill only. The neighbouring Erlebnispark amusement park is not part of the zoo boundary.
